Third-party Partner Extensions

Extend your workflows with partner solutions and exclusive offers on Podio Premium.

Integrated All-in-One Phone System from smrtPhone

Experience the power of deep integration with the only phone system and power dialer built for Podio. Ready to go in 5 minutes and flexible to all stages of your growth. Podio Premium organisations get $100 of free credit.

Interactive Sales Dashboard from Plecto

Experience the power of visualization that provides the transparency you need to go the extra mile. Create real-time interactive dashboards to measure your team's sales performance. Podio Premium organizations can measure up to 10 sales agents with a 50% discount for 3 months!

*Partner extensions are billed separately by their respective providers. Offers may vary by partner or over time.
